title: 商务：见面与寒暄
goal: 商务场合会自我介绍、递名片、介绍同事，能接住对方的寒暄（航班、倒时差、对城市的印象）。
tips: 初次见面说 Nice to meet you，告别时说 Nice meeting you / It was nice to meet you.
对方说 Please call me Mark. 之后就直接叫名字，不用再加 Mr.
寒暄常见三问：How was your flight? / Is this your first time here? / How do you like the city? 准备好一两句回答。

exchanges.hear: Hi, I'm Mark Johnson from ABC Company. Nice to meet you.
exchanges.hearZh: 你好，我是ABC公司的马克·约翰逊。很高兴见到你。
exchanges.reply: Nice to meet you too. I'm Li Na. Here's my card.
exchanges.replyZh: 我也很高兴见到你。我是李娜，这是我的名片。

exchanges.reply: It was long, but it was OK. Thanks for asking.
exchanges.replyZh: 挺长的，不过还好。谢谢关心。

exchanges.hear: Is this your first time in New York?
exchanges.reply: No, I was here two years ago.
A little. I didn't sleep well last night.

exchanges.hear: What do you do at your company?
exchanges.reply: I'm in charge of overseas sales.

exchanges.hear: Let me introduce my colleague, Sarah.
exchanges.hearZh: 我来介绍一下我的同事莎拉。
exchanges.reply: Hi, Sarah. Nice to meet you.
exchanges.replyZh: 你好，莎拉，很高兴认识你。

exchanges.hear: How do you like the city so far?
exchanges.hearZh: 到目前为止你觉得这座城市怎么样？
exchanges.reply: I love it. The food is great.
exchanges.replyZh: 我很喜欢，这里的食物很棒。

exchanges.hear: Can I get you some coffee or tea?

lines.en: Good morning! You must be Mr. Zhao. I'm Emily Brown, the purchasing manager.
lines.zh: 早上好！您一定是赵先生吧。我是采购经理艾米丽·布朗。

lines.en: Good morning, Ms. Brown. Nice to meet you. Here's my card.
lines.zh: 早上好，布朗女士。很高兴见到您，这是我的名片。

lines.en: Thank you. Please call me Emily. How was your trip?
lines.zh: 谢谢。叫我艾米丽就好。旅途怎么样？

lines.en: It was a long flight, but everything went well.
lines.zh: 飞行时间挺长的，不过一切顺利。

lines.en: Yes, at the Westin. It's just ten minutes from here.
lines.zh: 是的，住在威斯汀，离这里只有十分钟。

lines.en: Great. Can I get you a coffee before the meeting?
lines.zh: 太好了。开会前给您来杯咖啡吗？
好的，谢谢。黑咖啡，不加糖。

lines.en: Let me introduce you to my colleague, David. He's in charge of quality control.
lines.zh: 我给您介绍一下我的同事大卫，他负责质量控制。
